title: Protocol for Quantitative Analysis of Synaptic Vesicle Clustering in Axons of Cultured Neurons
protocol: Euthanize the pregnant female rat according to guidelines approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee.
Remove the uterus from the euthanized dam.
Free individual fetuses from the embryonic sack and place them into a sterile Petri dish.
Decapitate each fetus or pup.
Remove skin and skull from each decapitated fetus or pup.
Place the brain in a 60-mm Petri dish containing ice-cold Hank’s Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) on an ice pack.
Under the dissecting microscope, dissect hippocampi or cortices one at a time in a 100-mm Petri dish with dissection solution covering the tissue.
Remove meninges and transfer the hippocampus or cortex to a 35-mm Petri dish containing HBSS.
Transfer hippocampi or cortices to a 15-mL conical tube containing freshly prepared papain solution.
Incubate the tube with hippocampi or cortices at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Wash coverslips three times with deionized water during the incubation step.
Place washed coverslips in wells of a 12-well plate and add 1.5 mL of warmed CNB medium to each well.
Remove papain solution using a 1-mL pipette after the incubation period.
Add 5 mL of HBSS to the conical tube with hippocampi or cortices, close it, and invert gently.
Let the tissues settle for about 2 minutes and then remove the HBSS.
Repeat steps 9 through 10 two more times.
Add 1 mL of CNB medium to the tissue suspension.
Triturate the tissues 40 times with a fire-polished Pasteur pipette while avoiding air bubbles introduction.
Dilute 20 μL of cell suspension into 180 μL of plating media and count cells on a hemocytometer.
Plate 3.0 × 10^5 cells onto 18-mm poly-D-lysine-coated coverslips in wells containing warmed CNB medium.
Maintain the cultures at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Replace the medium with fresh CNB medium the next day.
At about DIV7, check the quality of the plated neurons by observing them under a microscope.
For each transfection, prepare Solution A in a sterile microcentrifuge tube according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Mix 8 μg of pCAGG-VGLUT1-Venus plasmid DNA with 9 μL of a 2 M CaCl2 solution and sufficient deionized water to bring the total volume to 75 μL for Solution A.
Prepare Solution B consisting of 75 μL of 2× HBS.
Carefully vortex Solution A while adding Solution B dropwise.
Incubate the mixed A+B solution at 24°C–26°C for 30 min.
Transfer a coverslip with plated neurons to another 12-well plate containing 2 mL of MEM and 10 μL of 1 M MgCl2 using forceps.
Retain the 12-well plate containing CNB medium conditioned by the original cultures of coverslip-plated neurons.
Gently vortex the transfection (A+B) solution.
Add the transfection solution dropwise to wells of a 12-well plate containing coverslip-plated neurons.
Gently move the plate back and forth to evenly distribute the transfection solution.
Incubate the plate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator for 15 minutes.
If precipitates are not detected under a microscope, incubate for an additional 5–10 minutes.
Prepare 6-well plates containing 2 mL of HBSS per well (three wells needed).
Transfer the coverslip to the first well of a 6-well plate containing 2 mL of HBSS and gently shake the plate.
Transfer the coverslip to the second well of a 6-well plate containing 2 mL of HBSS and gently shake the plate.
Transfer the coverslip to the third well of a 6-well plate containing 2 mL of HBSS and gently shake the plate.
Transfer the coverslip to the 12-well plate containing the original neuron-conditioned CNB medium.
Assess transfection success by monitoring VGLUT1-Venus fluorescence in neurons under a fluorescence microscope twenty-four hours later.
At DIV14, aspirate CNB medium from 12-well plates.
Wash coverslip-plated neurons by adding ice-cold PBS.
Inspect all transfected neurons under a fluorescence microscope to ensure viability and health.
Add fixing solution and incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the fixing solution.
Wash neurons by adding ice-cold PBS.
Repeat Step 32 twice more.
Add permeabilization solution to 12-well plates and incubate at 24°C–26°C for 10 min.
Aspirate the permeabilization solution.
Incubate with PBS-BH solution at 24°C–26°C for 15 min to block nonspecific binding of antibodies.
Prepare 100 μL of primary antibody solution (anti-Bassoon [diluted 1:100] and anti-GFP [diluted in 1:1,000] in PBS-BH solution) per coverslip.
Place a 100-μL drop of primary antibody solution on a parafilm-coated plate for each coverslip.
Retrieve the coverslips using forceps, and place onto drops of primary antibody solution.
Incubate at 24°C–26°C for 1 h.
Wash coverslip-plated neurons by transferring coverslips to wells of a 12-well plate filled with 1× PBS.
Repeat Step 37 once more.
Prepare 100 μL of secondary antibody solution.
Place 100 μL drop of secondary antibody solution on a parafilm-coated plate for each coverslip.
Retrieve coverslips using forceps and place onto drops of secondary antibody solution.
Incubate at 24°C–26°C for 1 h.
Cover plates with foil to minimize light exposure.
Wash coverslip-plated neurons by transferring coverslips to wells of a 12-well plate filled with 1× PBS.
Repeat washing step once more.
Prepare microscope slides and place a drop of VECTASHIELD antifade mounting medium on the surface of the slide.
Retrieve coverslips from the 12-well plate using forceps and place on slide glasses with neurons facing down.
Seal each coverslip with transparent nail polish.
Separate RGB colors in images using Photoshop and save each image in gray mode in Tiff file format.
Open gray image files corresponding to transfected neurons expressing VGLUT1-mVenus into MetaMorph software.
Calibrate pixel length in images using the Length Calibration Function in MetaMorph.
Set the threshold using the Threshold Function (minimum, 100; maximum, 255) such that pixels above the minimum threshold take on an orange coloration.
Draw a straight line across each orange region to measure presynaptic bouton length.
Open gray images files corresponding to Bassoon puncta in MetaMorph software.
Draw a line surrounding an axonal bouton labeled with VGLUT1-Venus to define the region of interest (ROI).
Save each ROI in Rgn file format.
Calibrate pixel length in images using the Length Calibration Function.
Set the threshold using the Threshold Function with a minimum value of 100 and maximum value of 255.
Load saved ROIs for the gray image corresponding to Bassoon puncta.
Open a Region Measurement window.
Click Open Log to link to Microsoft Excel.
Click Log Data to export data to an Excel sheet.
